Appearance

Wiry human male in a ratty leather coat hung with traps and snares. Smells faintly of sewer water.

What We Know

Vex is an independent pest controller who operates outside the Exterminators Guild. He's cheaper than the guild but works without official oversight. He seems to know the city's tunnel systems very well.

First Impressions

Shifty and resentful — talks about the Exterminators Guild the way an ex talks about their former partner.
